## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 ago 2026 - 24 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Laura Friedman_, 24 ago 2026, 1/5: "This newly made over health app, that the phone promotes as essential, requires at least two paid subscriptions, of dubious value, to function. Samsung is trying to be as morally bankrupt as Apple. Welcome to the world of being lied to so they can take your money. Samsung advertised these phones and watches that are exorbitantly expensive and then ruined the previous app so that Samsung, Google, and their ilk can grift right on. Shame isn't evidently something that exists anymore."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 26 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _brad herran_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "I downloaded this app because my sleep app stopped tracking my steps. This app is great for tracking steps, but the bloatware (notices, promotions, personal info it won't stop bugging you to enter, etc) that you can't turn off or delete, makes it unusable - no simply annoying - for what I wanted - and expected in the app."
            2. _Yugoslav Warlord_, 26 ago 2026, 1/5: "Great app but WHY do we have to change how it looks??? If it wasn't broken before don't fix it. 7.0 looks horrible, the trend of enshittification is getting annoying. You've also removed the one thing that interested me the most, that being the festure where I can see the speed at which I was going at a certain point in the workout. Now all you show me is the average. NOBODY CARES ABOUT THE AVERAGE, STOP REMOVING FEATURES. I'm regretting owning a Samsung because of this. Ridiculous."
            3. _JWM B_, 24 jul 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
